note: Assumptions behind some figures of the n8n Performance Dashboard. They are NOT measurements. Replace them with your own values, then run: npm run sync:automation (sample) or npm run sync:automation -- --live. Prices are placeholders, not a price list: use the prices of your contract.

llm.note: Estimated model cost = runs x model nodes in the workflow x assumed tokens per call x assumed price. n8n does not report tokens in the data this dashboard reads, so every run is assumed to call every model node once.
